proposal.reason: Main change is CI execution reliability and source-pairing logic across test/build workflows: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds registry auth, ref-time commit pinning, and paired pccl-tests branch/commit resolution; .github/workflows/source-sanity.yml and pccl-daily-full.yml propagate resolved pccl-tests revisions and adjust runner-hash gating/fallback behavior. .github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh changes CI build-pass ordering and unsets LDFLAGS for the test pass to restore unit-test linking in the workflow row. These are test/build workflow orchestration changes (CI scope) rather than review-policy automation (workflow module) or core build-system rule changes.
